rationale: The regression is witnessed twice and now causally controlled, but every witness so far widened the window by holding the store write open, so the honest thing left to say is how often the interleaving happens on its own. This turn spends one execution on that bound rather than on another deliberate demonstration: the same single node and the same fast-path transport, no instrumented store at all, with the node kept cycling between being deposed by empty heartbeats and starting its own election while the heartbeat stream continues, and the term sampled continuously for a fall below the highest term the node has already adopted. Any fall observed there is a monotonicity violation under natural timing and would make the finding deployment-relevant rather than demonstration-only; no fall in the window bounds the natural rate at the measured number of deliveries instead of refuting the mechanism. The operand that makes the negative interpretable is the delivery count, because a window a microsecond wide cannot be hit by chance often, so the count is the rate denominator rather than a bare absence.

investigations.discriminator: Hold the main loop's term write open by supplying a stable store whose write of the current term can be armed to block once, deliver one empty heartbeat with a term well above the current one on the fast path while it is held, then release and read both the in-memory term and the persisted term: a term after release lower than the term adopted during the hold witnesses a durable term regression caused by the off-thread write. Executed twice with the same operands (CheckRuns d5d2d6e4b4304f65ba05d1869b42fa3c and f5bfa53fce5c4314a29fe898c38b8808), and the control with the same hold and no heartbeat delivered (68ee55636577494e915fce091da4d876) shows the held write alone is monotone, so the fall is attributable to the off-thread write. A natural-timing probe is now queued that repeats the cycles with no instrumentation at all and counts falls per delivery, to bound the rate at which the interleaving happens on its own rather than only demonstrating that it is possible.

knowledge.assertion: the candidate path reads the current term, computes the next one and writes it with no guard around the pair, so a higher term written off the main thread in between is overwritten in memory and in the stable store
with the same hold and nothing delivered during it, the term and the persisted term step from the held 3 to 4 and the node leads, so the held write alone is monotone

scope.description: Natural-timing probe for the term-regression interleaving: on a real single-node cluster with no instrumented store, cycle the node between being deposed by empty heartbeats and starting its own election while continuing to deliver heartbeats, sample the term continuously, and emit one CA_EVENT JSON line counting deliveries, samples, failures and falls together with the highest adopted term and the final term, persisted term and state.
assumptions: The node is a single voter, so every election it starts is winnable and every depose is real, which keeps the cycles frequent without peers.

The term only ever increases in this implementation unless the off-thread write overwrites a higher one, so a sampled term below the highest adopted term is a monotonicity violation rather than a legitimate decrease.

Deliveries, not elapsed time, are the denominator of the rate: a window a microsecond wide cannot be expected to be hit in a short probe, so an observed zero bounds the rate at that delivery count and does not refute the mechanism.
The heartbeat that triggers the off-thread write comes from the harness wrapper, which mirrors the network transport's classification and dispatch rather than exercising its socket path.

experiment.prefix: The harness (draft/assurance_generated_test.go) is one TestAssurance-prefixed test plus the local transport wrapper it shares with the other fast-path experiments. It creates an in-memory transport, wraps it so strictly empty AppendEntries requests are dispatched to the installed handler on the caller's goroutine with a bounded response wait, bootstraps a single-voter configuration with BootstrapCluster and starts the node with NewRaft over a plain in-memory store, snapshot store and MockFSM, then waits (bounded) for Leader state. It records the highest adopted term as the node's term at that point, then loops for six seconds: it sleeps about one election interval so the node can start an election, then delivers a short burst of empty heartbeats, each three terms above the node's current term, spaced a couple of milliseconds apart. After each delivery it reads the node's term and raises the highest adopted term when the node has moved up, and counts a fall whenever the sampled term is below the highest adopted term, recording the first such fall with its operands. It finishes by printing one CA_EVENT JSON line with the delivery count, failure count, sample count, fall count, the first fall, the highest adopted term, the final term, the persisted term and the node's final state, then shuts the node down.
